Card Q&A.a: A [Breeding] effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the breeding area. Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the breeding area.

[Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: What order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?
I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards in my breeding area. Can I use this card's inherited effect to suspend that Digimon and play this card itself from digivolution cards?

Effect: [On Play] If you have 1 or fewer security cards, this Digimon may digivolve into [Omnimon (X Antibody)] in the hand, ignoring digivolution requirements and without paying the cost.
[On Deletion] You may place this card as the bottom digivolution card of your [King Drasil_7D6] in the breeding area.
Inherited Effect: {Breeding} [Opponent's Turn] When your security stack is removed from, by suspending this Digimon, play 1 [Omekamon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
